provenance: C3 was measured on a clean committed tree. Dense timing includes Worker/SDK await instrumentation and is not described as a clean-tree timing. The product base is the same 4ded56c3b; the exact trace patches and independent-cell selection are retained. Neither sample measures the later stale-startup guard.

attributedFixes.fix: SDK input blocks release before the awaited restore hook; the original reset was attributed to container.js:641 awaiting onStart and the boot-id RPC.
Every chunked-format fallback persists and logs a named reason. The original 2GiB sparse failure was missing hashes from an oversized sha256sum argv; bounded find batches fix it.
Opaque directory records mask the base at delta/tree while preserving whole and higher chunked records; native probe, reader validation, Docker and Lean coverage are present.

Live reseat ran from /workspace and failed EBUSY, leaving zero base hashes. Storage commands now use /var/tmp/devbox; failed reseats refuse. The traced control then found 4092 matching blocks of 4096 and published 69632 bytes.

Cloud and Docker report plain fuse for the block mount. The readiness predicate now uses that measured type plus the unchanged exact source/generation checks; wrong type, wrong generation and missing mount remain red.

Stale buffered startup rows no longer reopen the hook around a ready running container. The dense trace showed one unnecessary adoption waiting 14814ms behind the active writer; the guard is red/green pinned locally.

cleanup.bothRuns: Worker, container application, boxes, bucket and generated configuration removed; driver and tail processes stopped

remaining: The C3 payload bound now passes, but s3fs still performs two zero-byte directory/placeholder PUTs plus the final payload write. The one-attempt gate remains red and O1 is not full strategy admission.
